hook.name: SatoHook
hook.description: Bonding curve hook for an ETH/SATO pool that replaces AMM liquidity entirely using BeforeSwapDelta. Buys mint SATO via a forward curve; sells burn SATO via an inverse curve paid from ETH reserves held by the hook. A 0.3% fee is skimmed on all trades. Requires hookData encoding the swapper address; a per-user block-number cooldown applies between buys and sells.
